craft_notes: Sthāyin: exclusivity-joy (no other). Sanskrit first: negation + exception (ṛte) + correlative (yaḥ...sa) → L4 keeps no/but/who-he marching. Rows: row 3 (no/except frame). Rupture: period after her — exception done, follower begins. Close: end-weight on gladness. Minimal pass: period for L3 semicolon. Read aloud: no! but. glad. Rejected: 'blissful' for sukhī — killed: happy plain (bliss reserved for ānanda); 'cling to' for anusaran — killed: following walks, clinging grasps.

lines: No way but following your being. Keep to her,
rest in self — the follower is glad.
l4.sanskrit_cite: upāyo nāparaḥ kaścit svasattānugamād ṛte / tām evānusaran yogī svastho yaḥ sa sukhī bhavet

reads_against.argmap: No means but following own being; the follower, abiding, is happy.
c1_essence: No means but following own being; follower abides, happy.
